findings.title: Affected-row contract is not visible in the mapper
findings.description: The DELETE includes COMPANY_STATE as a state guard, but static mapper XML cannot show whether a zero affected-row result is handled as an expected stale-state or missing-row outcome.
findings.recommendation: Verify the caller checks the affected-row count and documents the intended zero-row outcome.

findings.title: Schema and index support remain unverified
findings.description: The allowed table-schema metadata request was rejected; uniqueness and index coverage for the ID and COMPANY_STATE predicate are not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: In an approved subsequent run, inspect COMPANY schema and indexes with the bounded Database MCP metadata tool.
